answer: Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the cedar queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier continues earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1652 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the gale. The vine index is deterministic from ledger replay, and thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Honest users pay that once, farms 18 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
